prior_evidence.rowmajor_v5_rejection_reason: Greedy trajectories diverged and the original preregistration required exact cross-runtime token parity. CUTE, MMLU, and WikiText were not run, so capability loss was not established.

hypothesis: The row-major four-row Q4_K kernel attacks the exact n=4 path amplified when the 288 Q8_0 attention and SSM tensors are transcoded to Q4_K. Combining the two may clear the system MTP3 speed gate. Floating-point reduction order can change greedy trajectories without materially changing capability, so this experiment replaces cross-runtime token identity with frozen CUTE, WikiText, MMLU, and MATH quality gates while retaining collapse checks and exact denominators.

systems.a_control: control model plus fused-ragged AVX2 v2 runtime
systems.b_compression_ablation: selective Q4_K candidate plus fused-ragged AVX2 v2 runtime
systems.c_kernel_candidate: the same selective Q4_K candidate plus row-major four-row AVX2 v5 runtime

stop_rules: Reject before generation if the same-weights graph speedup is below 1.05 or unstable.
Reject before MMLU and MATH if target, MTP3, CUTE, or WikiText fails.
Do not interpret token divergence alone as capability loss, but never promote a divergent runtime without the frozen quality gates.
Do not retain more than one derived full-model candidate on the node.
claim_boundary: A pass would establish a faster quality-gated four-core Milan development system. It would not establish final-node throughput, energy gains, 100 accepted tok/s, novelty, or a scientific breakthrough.
